definitions.gloss: commemorative photo; souvenir photo; memorial photograph
definitions.explanation: A photograph taken to commemorate a special occasion, event, or visit to a notable place.

examples.japanese: {記念写真|きねんしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}ろう→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{記念写真|きねんしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: We took a commemorative photo at the graduation ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{記念写真|きねんしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: We had someone take a group commemorative photo of our whole family at the tourist spot.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧ (commemoration, memorial) and ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (photograph). A ubiquitous concept in Japanese culture, where taking {記念写真|きねんしゃしん} is a standard part of ceremonies, school events, travel, and social gatherings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記念写真|きねんしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take a commemorative photo
- {記念写真|きねんしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to have someone take a commemorative photo
- ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧{記念写真|きねんしゃしん}: group commemorative photo
- {記念写真|きねんしゃしん}⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: commemorative photo shoot

USAGE:
At Japanese events like ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧ (entrance ceremonies), ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ (graduations), ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧ (weddings), and company events, taking a {記念写真|きねんしゃしん} is almost obligatory. At tourist sites, it is common to ask strangers or staff to take your photo — the phrase {記念写真|きねんしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ is frequently used.
